stimuli.description: A furnished living room (4.7m x 4.4m x 3.1m) with windows shielded, containing a TV, entertainment center, sofas, coffee table, side table with flowers, wall shelves, and a rug. Two lighting conditions were tested: 1) direct/indirect lighting (400 lx downlight, 300 lx uplight) and 2) direct lighting (700 lx downlight). Illuminance (700 lx) and color temperature (5000K) were controlled.
stimuli.source: Fig. 1, Environmental setting, Design and procedure

tables.description: Within-group subjective parameter comparisons (mean, SD, t-value) for direct/indirect vs direct lighting conditions.

limitations: Subjective feelings can be altered by other variables like sunshine, lighting hardware, suspended lighting length, interior decoration.
Multiple comparisons were not employed due to the exploratory nature, increasing possibility of type 1 error.
Participants might have assumed the hypothesis, influencing results.
Sample size, while sufficient for EEG, is small for generalization of results.
